results.model: two serialized successful mutations cannot share one expected revision
results.hypotheses: First successful mutation publishes r+1 under a process-global lock before second comparison; no rollback/external writer. Does not prove locking or persistence implementation.
results.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun revision () Int)
(declare-fun expected () Int)
(assert
 (>= revision 0))
(assert
 (< revision 9223372036854775807))
(assert
 (= expected revision))
(assert
 (let (($x111 (= expected revision)))
(and $x111 (= expected (+ revision 1)))))
(check-sat)

results.model: UTF8 scalar bytes <= three times UTF16 units
results.hypotheses: Explicit standard UTF8/UTF16 scalar-width model; rejects unpaired surrogates. Not proof of a platform encoder.
results.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun scalar () Int)
(assert
 (>= scalar 0))
(assert
 (<= scalar 1114111))
(assert
 (or (< scalar 55296) (> scalar 57343)))
(assert
 (let (($x69 (<= scalar 65535)))
(let ((?x63 (ite $x69 3 4)))
(let (($x49 (<= scalar 2047)))
(let ((?x59 (ite $x49 2 ?x63)))
(let (($x68 (<= scalar 127)))
(let ((?x62 (ite $x68 1 ?x59)))
(> ?x62 (* 3 (ite $x69 1 2))))))))))
(check-sat)
